summary: Unpredictable single insert performance due to blocking and excessive indexes.
symptoms: Single record insert performance is extremely poor.
Blocking sessions appear in sys.dm_exec_requests but are not active.
mechanism: Blocking caused by uncommitted transactions and contention on locks, exacerbated by excessive indexes.

facts.evidence: The table is described as having 8 million rows.
The table has 34 indexes in addition to a clustered index.
Blocked requests are waiting for LCK_M_S.
Blocking sessions are sleeping and have no active requests.

assumptions: The blocking behavior is reproducible under synthetic conditions.
Excessive indexes contribute to contention during inserts.
Uncommitted transactions are a primary cause of blocking.
unknowns: Exact schema of the Communication table.
Specific workload patterns leading to contention.
Whether other factors like disk I/O or memory pressure contribute.
